manifest.title: Why the Commodity Winners Sold Early
manifest.description: Trade-by-trade diagnosis of the August 26 GOLD and SILVER take-profit exits.

blocks.body: # Why the Commodity Winners Sold Early

## Executive Summary

- **The shared winner gateway never became eligible.** GOLD and SILVER sold with 315.8 and 315.6 seconds left—about 15 seconds outside its final-300-second window.
- **Both contracts won.** The exits made $9.83 versus $12.83 at settlement, leaving $3.00 on the table; this was a shared boundary-rule defect, not a commodity-only path or feed failure.

## Recommended next steps

**Remove the 300-second boundary, let exceptionally strong book evidence hold on its own, and regression-test the time/probability edges against full counterfactual history.** These settlements are authoritative; the open question is performance after rare late reversals.

sources.label: Live trade ledger: trades, position evaluations, and exit counterfactuals

query.description: Selects the two latest live commodity exits, their final exit evaluations, and the authoritative hold-to-settlement counterfactuals.
filters: trade_id in the two most recent GOLD and SILVER exits
metric_definitions: Realized exit P&L is net proceeds after exit fees minus total entry debit.
Settlement P&L is the authoritative winning payout minus total entry debit.
Profit left is settlement P&L minus realized exit P&L.
query.sql: SELECT t.asset, t.ticker, CAST(t.entry_price AS REAL) AS entry_price, CAST(p.executable_exit_price AS REAL) AS exit_bid, CAST(p.model_probability AS REAL) AS model_probability, p.seconds_to_close AS seconds_left, CAST(c.realized_exit_pnl AS REAL) AS realized_pnl, CAST(c.hold_pnl AS REAL) AS settlement_pnl, CAST(c.delta_hold_minus_exit AS REAL) AS opportunity_cost FROM trades t JOIN position_evaluations p ON p.trade_id = t.trade_id AND p.verdict = 'exit' JOIN exit_counterfactuals c ON c.trade_id = t.trade_id WHERE t.trade_id IN ('1e5df9ad-f5c0-410e-9fb6-50a51ad92829', '86b86769-3d45-4f52-acf0-fb11034e2dd9') ORDER BY p.evaluated_at DESC;

query.description: Compares commodity and crypto take-profit exits recorded since the current live process started.
metric_definitions: Outside-window exits have more than 300 seconds remaining at the final exit evaluation.
query.sql: WITH exits AS (SELECT t.trade_id, t.asset, p.seconds_to_close, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.trade_id ORDER BY p.evaluated_at DESC) AS rn FROM trades t JOIN position_evaluations p ON p.trade_id = t.trade_id AND p.verdict = 'exit' WHERE t.mode = 'live' AND t.exited_at >= '2026-08-26T02:28:37+00:00') SELECT CASE WHEN asset IN ('GOLD','SILVER','WTI') THEN 'Commodity' ELSE 'Crypto' END AS asset_class, COUNT(*) AS exit_count, SUM(seconds_to_close > 300) AS outside_window, AVG(seconds_to_close) AS average_seconds_left FROM exits WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY asset_class;

sources.label: Production take-profit policy and default settings

query.description: The active-winner predicate used for every open live position, with no asset-specific branch.
query.query:
winning_now = (seconds <= take_profit_winning_hold_max_seconds_to_close and book.bid >= take_profit_winning_hold_min_bid and model_probability >= take_profit_winning_hold_min_probability)
# Defaults: max_seconds_to_close=300, min_bid=0.90, min_probability=0.65
